name: Doumae Akira
source:
"If you've got the time to sit around and think, just go out with me.
Don't worry. You'll fall for me soon enough."

A super idol from under the star of frivolity
Ore-sama x Player x Hard worker

Member of HEARTiS. His vocal prowess puts him a cut above the rest of the group.
He's bright, yet overbearing and always seems to be full of confidence.
Gossip about his involvement with women is constant; he's a carnivore.
Then again, he acts like an idiot at times, so he's hard to truly dislike.
He hates losing and puts a lot of effort into his work.

Hobby: all kinds of physical training (especially skateboarding)
Likes: nikujaga, women
Hates: ghosts

[Translated from [url=http://www.entremets-cd.com/products/stalove]official website[/url]]
